slides.title: 1991 on. Best: 1994–95.
slides.body: 1991 brought the fuel-injected 4.0 six. 1994–95 manuals have an external clutch slave, so no pulling the gearbox to replace it.

slides.title: Careful with 1997–99.
slides.body: Seven recalls for 1997, early computer and fuel-system bugs, and a cowl vent that leaks onto the floors. Exhaust manifolds crack most on 1997–2000.

slides.title: 2012 on, for the Pentastar.
slides.body: 2007–11 trucks have the 3.8 and a four-speed auto. 2012 brought the 285 hp 3.6 and a five-speed.

slides.title: Be careful with a 2018.
slides.body: Recalls for track-bar bracket welds, the steering shaft and rear frame rails, plus 1,000+ complaints, mostly highway wander. Only with every fix documented.
